configurePresets.name: host
configurePresets.description: Host build defaults. NXWARP_BUILD_VK is left at the repository default (OFF): vk/ needs the Vulkan headers and an ICD, and a preset that fails to configure on a machine without them is a preset nobody uses. Turn it on with the -vk presets, or -DNXWARP_BUILD_VK=ON.

configurePresets.name: vk
configurePresets.description: Vulkan on: needs Vulkan headers, the loader, glslang and an ICD.

configurePresets.name: no-vk
configurePresets.description: Vulkan off: cross builds and the pure-CPU checks.

configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: The everyday build. Debug, Ninja, assertions on, instrumentation off so it is fast to rebuild and pleasant to step through. CPU components only; use dev-vk for the Vulkan path.

configurePresets.name: dev-vk
configurePresets.displayName: dev-vk - dev plus the Vulkan encoder/decoder
configurePresets.description: dev with NXWARP_BUILD_VK=ON. Needs the Vulkan headers, the loader and glslang; run scripts/bootstrap.sh if configure complains about any of them.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: What ships. RelWithDebInfo keeps the frame pointers and line tables that a decode-time profile needs; cpack runs out of this directory.

configurePresets.name: release-lto
configurePresets.description: Release with interprocedural optimisation. Slower to link, and the only configuration in which the encoder's inlining across component boundaries is representative. Measure against 'release' before believing a number from either.

configurePresets.name: asan-ubsan
configurePresets.description: The bitstream-safety build. UBSan does not recover, so a signed overflow in the reference decoder aborts the test rather than printing a line nobody reads. Run the conformance suite here before touching ref/.

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: For transport/ and the encoder's pipelining only; the reference codec is single-threaded by rule. TSan cannot be combined with ASan, hence its own directory.

configurePresets.name: gcc
configurePresets.description: Explicit GCC build, mirroring the linux-gcc CI job.

configurePresets.name: clang
configurePresets.description: Explicit Clang build, mirroring the linux-clang CI job. Two compilers disagreeing about a warning is cheap; two compilers disagreeing about the bitstream is the bug this catches.

configurePresets.name: coverage
configurePresets.description: Instrumented for line coverage. Debug because optimised coverage maps lie about which branch ran. scripts/build-all.sh coverage produces the report.

configurePresets.name: fuzz
configurePresets.description: libFuzzer entry points, NXVC_FUZZ=ON. Clang only. Tests are off: the fuzz targets are the tests here, and the nightly workflow seeds them from tests/vectors/.

configurePresets.name: mingw-w64
configurePresets.description: Portability check with llvm-mingw. Builds the CPU components only and runs no tests; see cmake/toolchains/mingw-w64.cmake for where the toolchain is found and how to point it elsewhere.

configurePresets.name: android-ndk
configurePresets.description: The headset target. Vulkan is on because the compute decoder is the reason this build exists; tests are off because ctest cannot run an arm64 binary on the host. Pair it with bench/ for on-device numbers.

testPresets.name: vk-only
testPresets.displayName: Vulkan tests (needs an ICD; lavapipe is enough)

packagePresets.name: release
packagePresets.displayName: TGZ + ZIP (+ DEB where dpkg exists)

workflowPresets.name: ci
workflowPresets.displayName: CI: configure, build and test the default host configuration

workflowPresets.name: ci-mingw
workflowPresets.displayName: CI: Windows cross-compile check, build only
